# krb — Kerberos

[All groups](README.md)

## krb kinit

Get a Kerberos TGT (AS exchange) with a password or keytab and report it: flags, lifetimes, encryption types and the KDC's salt. Also probes whether the KDC enforces pre-authentication (AS-REP roasting) and measures clock skew.

MCP tool: `krb_kinit`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--principal` | string | Client principal, user or user@REALM. |
| `--realm` | string | Realm, if not in principal. |
| `--kdc` | list | KDC host[:port] list; default from krb5_conf or DNS SRV records. |
| `--krb5-conf` | string | krb5.conf to use instead of kdc/etypes (a path from the CLI or a profile). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--password` | string | Password (prefer env IDPDBG_PASSWORD or a profile). Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_PASSWORD`, redacted in traces. |
| `--keytab` | string | Client keytab instead of a password (a path, or base64). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--etypes` | list | Encryption types to request. Default `aes256-cts-hmac-sha1-96,aes128-cts-hmac-sha1-96,aes256-cts-hmac-sha384-192,aes128-cts-hmac-sha256-128`. |
| `--check-preauth` | bool | Send an AS-REQ without pre-authentication first to see whether the KDC demands it. Default `true`. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## krb service_ticket

Get a service ticket (TGS exchange) for an SPN and report its encryption type (RC4 means Kerberoastable), key version and flags. With the service keytab it also decrypts the ticket and decodes and verifies the PAC (groups, SIDs, UPN). Can emit a ready Negotiate header.

MCP tool: `krb_service_ticket`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--principal` | string | Client principal, user or user@REALM. |
| `--realm` | string | Realm, if not in principal. |
| `--kdc` | list | KDC host[:port] list; default from krb5_conf or DNS SRV records. |
| `--krb5-conf` | string | krb5.conf to use instead of kdc/etypes (a path from the CLI or a profile). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--password` | string | Password (prefer env IDPDBG_PASSWORD or a profile). Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_PASSWORD`, redacted in traces. |
| `--keytab` | string | Client keytab instead of a password (a path, or base64). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--etypes` | list | Encryption types to request. Default `aes256-cts-hmac-sha1-96,aes128-cts-hmac-sha1-96,aes256-cts-hmac-sha384-192,aes128-cts-hmac-sha256-128`. |
| `--spn` | string | Service principal name, e.g. HTTP/web.example.com. **Required.** |
| `--service-keytab` | string | The service's keytab, to decrypt the ticket and verify the PAC. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--spnego-token` | bool | Also return an Authorization: Negotiate header value. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## krb keytab

List a keytab's entries (principal, key version, encryption type, timestamp) and flag weak keys.

MCP tool: `krb_keytab`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--keytab` | string | Keytab (a path from the CLI or a profile, or base64). **Required.** May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## krb decode

Decode a Kerberos or SPNEGO message (hex, base64, or an Authorization: Negotiate header): AS-REQ/REP, TGS-REQ/REP, AP-REQ/REP, KRB-ERROR (with ETYPE-INFO2 salts), NegTokenInit/Resp (mechanisms, NTLM offered). With the service keytab it decrypts tickets and authenticators and verifies the PAC.

MCP tool: `krb_decode`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--message` | string | The message (CLI: @file or - for stdin). **Required.** CLI: `@path` reads a file, `-` reads stdin. |
| `--keytab` | string | Service keytab to decrypt tickets (a path, or base64). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## krb pac

Decode a Microsoft PAC (MS-PAC): logon info (user, groups and SIDs, logon server, account control), UPN/DNS info, client info, delegation info; verify its server signature with the service key.

MCP tool: `krb_pac`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--pac` | string | The PAC, hex or base64. **Required.** CLI: `@path` reads a file, `-` reads stdin. |
| `--keytab` | string | Service keytab to verify the signature. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--service-principal` | string | Service principal in the keytab, e.g. HTTP/web.example.com. |
| `--realm` | string | Realm of the service principal. |
| `--kvno` | int | Key version; 0 for the latest. Default `0`. |
| `--etype` | int | Encryption type of the key (18 = aes256-cts-hmac-sha1-96, 23 = rc4-hmac). Default `18`. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## krb fast

Get a TGT inside Kerberos FAST armoring (RFC 6113): checks the KDC advertises FAST, armors the AS exchange with a TGT (a machine account's, one from anonymous PKINIT, or the client's own), authenticates with the encrypted challenge factor and verifies the armored replies: integrity-protected errors, the KDC's own challenge, the strengthened reply key and the ticket checksum. With target_spn it also gets a service ticket with FAST and implicit armor. Returns ticket descriptions only, never usable tickets or keys.

MCP tool: `krb_fast`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--principal` | string | Client principal, user or user@REALM. |
| `--realm` | string | Realm, if not in principal. |
| `--kdc` | list | KDC host[:port] list; default from krb5_conf or DNS SRV records. |
| `--krb5-conf` | string | krb5.conf to use instead of kdc/etypes (a path from the CLI or a profile). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--password` | string | Password (prefer env IDPDBG_PASSWORD or a profile). Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_PASSWORD`, redacted in traces. |
| `--keytab` | string | Client keytab instead of a password (a path, or base64). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--etypes` | list | Encryption types to request. Default `aes256-cts-hmac-sha1-96,aes128-cts-hmac-sha1-96,aes256-cts-hmac-sha384-192,aes128-cts-hmac-sha256-128`. |
| `--armor-principal` | string | Principal whose TGT armors the request, usually a machine account (host/client.example.com, or CLIENT$ on Active Directory); default: the client itself. |
| `--armor-keytab` | string | Keytab of armor_principal (a path, or base64). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--armor-password` | string | Password of armor_principal. Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_ARMOR_PASSWORD`, redacted in traces. |
| `--armor-anonymous` | bool | Armor with a TGT from anonymous PKINIT (RFC 8062) instead: no machine account needed, and the KDC is authenticated by its certificate (pass its CA as ca_cert). |
| `--target-spn` | string | Also get a service ticket for this SPN inside FAST, e.g. HTTP/web.example.com. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## krb pkinit

Get a TGT with a certificate (PKINIT, RFC 4556): sign the AuthPack with the certificate's key and check the KDC's answer in Diffie-Hellman mode and in public-key encryption (RSA) mode: the KDC's signature, its certificate's chain, purpose and name, the nonce, the reply key binding (asChecksum) and the decrypted AS-REP. Also asks for a freshness token (RFC 8070) first and explains KDC refusals, including Active Directory's certificate mapping rules. With anonymous, runs anonymous PKINIT (RFC 8062) instead and checks the anonymous ticket and the KDC's key exchange (PA_PKINIT_KX).

MCP tool: `krb_pkinit`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--principal` | string | Client principal, user or user@REALM. |
| `--realm` | string | Realm, if not in principal. |
| `--kdc` | list | KDC host[:port] list; default from krb5_conf or DNS SRV records. |
| `--krb5-conf` | string | krb5.conf to use instead of kdc/etypes (a path from the CLI or a profile). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--etypes` | list | Encryption types to request. Default `aes256-cts-hmac-sha1-96,aes128-cts-hmac-sha1-96,aes256-cts-hmac-sha384-192,aes128-cts-hmac-sha256-128`. |
| `--pkinit-cert` | string | Client certificate (PEM), followed by any intermediates; with pkinit_piv_slot, only intermediates the card does not hold. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--pkinit-key` | string | The certificate's private key (PEM; RSA or ECDSA). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--pkinit-piv-slot` | string | Use the key and certificate in this PIV slot of a smart card or YubiKey instead (9a, 9c, 9d, 9e, 82-95); the key never leaves the card. |
| `--reader` | string | With pkinit_piv_slot: reader name or part of it; default the first reader. |
| `--piv-pin` | string | With pkinit_piv_slot: the PIV PIN; else IDPDBG_PIV_PIN or a no-echo prompt. Never tried with fewer than 2 attempts left, and never retried. Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_PIV_PIN`, redacted in traces. |
| `--mode` | string | Reply key delivery to try: Diffie-Hellman, public-key encryption (RSA keys only), or both. Default `both`. One of `both`, `dh`, `rsa`. |
| `--dh-group` | int | MODP group for Diffie-Hellman: 14 (2048-bit) or 2 (1024-bit). Default `14`. |
| `--freshness` | bool | Ask the KDC for a freshness token first (RFC 8070) and sign it into the AuthPack. Default `true`. |
| `--anonymous` | bool | Anonymous PKINIT (RFC 8062): get a TGT for WELLKNOWN/ANONYMOUS with no client certificate, only authenticating the KDC (Diffie-Hellman). Needs the realm, not a principal. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## krb s4u

Test Kerberos constrained delegation (MS-SFU) as a service account: S4U2Self gets a ticket to the service on behalf of a user (protocol transition) and reports whether it is forwardable; with target_spn, S4U2Proxy turns it into a ticket for that service (classic or resource-based constrained delegation). KDC refusals come back with what usually causes them. Returns ticket descriptions only, never usable tickets or keys.

MCP tool: `krb_s4u`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--principal` | string | Client principal, user or user@REALM. |
| `--realm` | string | Realm, if not in principal. |
| `--kdc` | list | KDC host[:port] list; default from krb5_conf or DNS SRV records. |
| `--krb5-conf` | string | krb5.conf to use instead of kdc/etypes (a path from the CLI or a profile). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--password` | string | Password (prefer env IDPDBG_PASSWORD or a profile). Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_PASSWORD`, redacted in traces. |
| `--keytab` | string | Client keytab instead of a password (a path, or base64). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--etypes` | list | Encryption types to request. Default `aes256-cts-hmac-sha1-96,aes128-cts-hmac-sha1-96,aes256-cts-hmac-sha384-192,aes128-cts-hmac-sha256-128`. |
| `--impersonate` | string | The user to act for: name, name@REALM, or a UPN. **Required.** |
| `--target-spn` | string | Service to delegate to (S4U2Proxy), e.g. cifs/files.example.com. |
| `--rbcd` | bool | Send PA-PAC-OPTIONS asking for resource-based constrained delegation (needed by Windows KDCs for RBCD). Default `true`. |
| `--target-keytab` | string | The target service's keytab, to decrypt the delegated ticket. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).
